in_marathi.name: Prakashan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prakashan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Prakashan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Prakash' which means 'Light'. This name is associated with the idea of illuminating knowledge and is believed to bring prosperity and success.
